newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures closed weaker.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures closed weaker.

text.p: UK grain futures again closed lower as lack of demand continued to afflict the market, with little direction forthcoming from CBOT grain futures.
Wheat futures closed 0.60 to 0.80 stg down after trading 538 lots while barley was 0.60 to 0.75 stg lower on 46 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures remained neglected.
Business on the delivered market was slight and prices eased in line with the futures. At the close selling levels were about 0.50 stg down on Wednesday.
